source_theorem_status: FC2 source theorem is treated as solved; this experiment refines visible support projections of already classified residual atoms

projection_conventions.h4_visible: atom-boundary H4 orbit lies in the input-side H4 image of the visible K_CH Fisher shadow
projection_conventions.h3_contraction_visible: atom-boundary H4 orbit is not H4-visible, but at least one H4-to-H3 contraction lands in the contraction shadow of that visible H4 image
projection_conventions.warning: Both channels are support projections.  Neither replaces the full filtered residual or makes K_CH an Ext_CH detector.

classification_convention.source: visible H3 shadow generated by pair-contractions of the exact input-side H4 image of K_CH
classification_convention.test: an H4-invisible residual atom is H3-contraction-visible when at least one pair contraction of its atom-boundary H4 cell lands in that generated H3 shadow
classification_convention.non_detection_warning: H3-contraction visibility is a support projection, not filtered closure and not K_CH as an Ext_CH detector
